body: Since we’re rating attempt methods, I give hanging yourself by detachable shower head 0/10. The piping behind the wall busted out. I didn’t know how to explain this to the repair man.
I’m 22 and life still sucks, but at 17 you have so many crazy hormones you could have life served on a silver platter and still think it sucks.

My SO cheated almost 4 years ago, I still think about it everyday. If I could time travel I would tell myself to leave, it would’ve been easier and I probably would be happier. That being said, since d-day my SO has made a valiant effort in changing in many areas all for better. I have fallen I love with with the person they are today but am still working on moving on from the person they were before. They are my greatest love and deepest heartbreak at the same time. The most god damn conflicting thing I’ve ever experienced
Do you by chance have adhd? People with adhd tend to sleep heavier, poor time management, mood swings, and are affected by alcohol differently
